stem.text: A stone is thrown horizontally from the top of a cliff and falls into the sea some time later. Air resistance is negligible.
Which graph shows how the vertical component $v_\text{v}$ of velocity of this stone varies with its horizontal component $v_\text{h}$ of velocity as it moves through the air?

A.alt: Graph with axes labelled v_v (vertical) and v_h (horizontal), both starting at 0, showing one curve.

B.alt: Graph with axes labelled v_v (vertical) and v_h (horizontal), both starting at 0, showing one curve.

C.alt: Graph with axes labelled v_v (vertical) and v_h (horizontal), both starting at 0, showing one horizontal straight line.

D.alt: Graph with axes labelled v_v (vertical) and v_h (horizontal), both starting at 0, showing one vertical straight line.
